data.name: Ancalin
data.gender_notes: Ancalin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ancalin is derived from Ancalia, the name of a Greek goddess. She was the protector of cities and fortresses, offering refuge and safety to those in need. Ancalin is a spiritual name, symbolizing a strong, unwavering faith and a deep commitment to providing shelter and security to those around us. The name Ancalin carries the meaning “Goddess of refuge and fortress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ancalin usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of refuge and fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection, refuge, and fortitude.
data.etymology: Ancalin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of refuge and fortress.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ancalin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name can inspire a sense of devotion, fortitude, and unwavering faith in one's beliefs and values.
